text: Android: notify when a collaborator changes a shared list (background sync already exists)

Done. SyncEngine detects pulled items whose account-scoped last_touched_by differs from the logged-in account (silent on cursor-0 hydration/full-resync, unknown own account, or null last_touched_by; account-scoped so a second device on one account never self-notifies) and reports raw per-list counts via a CollaboratorChangeNotifier seam. Android poster gates in order on app-foregrounded (change already on screen), global Settings toggle, per-list mutes (list properties), and POST_NOTIFICATIONS (runtime-requested on enable, API 33+); at most one batched notification per sync pass (fixed id), tap opens the affected list or overview when several lists changed. Prefs DataStore-backed, device-local, survive logout. account_id now stored at login. Verified: 2 consecutive clean full-suite runs + clean lint (a false-positive MissingPermission on the canPost()-gated notify() was @SuppressLint-ed). Commits 93d8d0a, 7dbf1cd, 3668d3b, 210f15a, 3103c92, d28b0aa, f5d4dd6 (plan 90cbc8c).
